# AEGISES

> Intelligence with integrity. Public reference architectures for governable intelligence and sovereign compute.

## AGI Reactor

Author: Ryan Smithright — [Qthonic Labs](https://qthonic.com/) — ryan@smithright.com.
AGI Reactor — A Safe, Governable Reference Architecture for Enterprise AGI.
Public design draft 1.3, 14 September 2026. Safety claims are scoped to the safeguards and trust assumptions specified in the architecture; this is not certification of a deployed system or a claim of general alignment.

- [Canonical article](https://aegises.org/agi-reactor/): Complete static HTML, interactive system map, safety case, coverage map and specification.
- [Complete plain-text article](https://aegises.org/agi-reactor/agi-reactor.txt): Generated from the same article, including diagram labels and the complete worked RFC; readable without JavaScript.
- [Technical specification](https://aegises.org/agi-reactor/architecture.md): Record semantics, concurrency, authority, effect recovery and upgrade contracts in Markdown.
- [RFC-001](https://aegises.org/agi-reactor/conformance/RFC-001.md): Accepted external effect, worker death and recovery from an UNKNOWN backup.
- [Executable reference specimen](https://github.com/Smithright/aegises.org/tree/main/agi-reactor/conformance): Guarded recovery and a deliberately failing negative control. An isolated HTTP/SQLite specimen, not production runtime qualification.
